review: Spring Loaded kills this build for me: all 100 ghosts stall at the second spring in front of the long spike row and time out, so no run can be completed. That is a hard blocker, not a difficulty problem. The rest has good flow. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are fast, readable and punish only bad timing. Gauntlet mixes every mechanic well, but the laser there killed the high-skill player, which looks like a cycle I cannot read early enough. Saw Mill kills at 50% with drifting saws that look partly random. First Steps is flat and slow.
best: Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate give fast, readable routes where each death is the fault of the player.
worst: Spring Loaded cannot be finished by anyone: every ghost is stuck at the spring before the spike row.
